# Synthetic location fixtures

These tiny files are generated test media; they contain no personal camera
images, account data or private location history. Their deliberately assigned
GPS point is **latitude -33.71000, longitude 150.31000, WGS84**.

- `gps.jpg`, `gps.png`, `gps.webp`: EXIF GPS IFD, S/E references and rational
  degrees/minutes/seconds, generated by Pillow.
- `gps-userdata.mp4` and `.mov`: `moov/udta/©xyz` static ISO 6709 text.
- `gps-keys.mp4` and `.mov`: `moov/meta/keys` maps the mdta key
  `com.apple.quicktime.location.ISO6709` to an `ilst` numeric item with UTF-8
  `data`. Altitude is present in the metadata but intentionally not mapped.
- `no-gps.*`: media without GPS. Video variants contain three actual 32×32
  MPEG-4 Visual frames, verified with OpenCV. Browser playback depends on codec
  support; metadata extraction does not require playback.

Run `python tests/fixtures/generate.py` from `vision-service/` to regenerate
with its existing Pillow, numpy and OpenCV dependencies. Video metadata is
appended to the trailing `moov` container, preserving sample byte offsets.
Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_location.py` for extraction,
missing/invalid GPS, canonical longitude, bounds/depth and endpoint checks.
HTTP/CORS tests use `httpx` through FastAPI's TestClient; it is a test-only
dependency available in the prepared local environment, not a runtime change.

Supported extraction is intentionally limited to JPEG/PNG/WebP EXIF GPS and
the two static decimal-degree QuickTime paths above (including `ilst/©xyz`).
XMP-only GPS, 3GPP `loci`, timed GPS tracks, proprietary camera telemetry and
HEIC/AVIF are not decoded. Missing or unsupported metadata requires an explicit
place/coordinate/current-location fallback, never inference from video frames.

Format references: [PNG eXIf](https://www.w3.org/TR/png-3/#eXIf),
[WebP EXIF container](https://developers.google.com/speed/webp/docs/riff_container#metadata),
[QuickTime location metadata](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quicktime-file-format/location_metadata),
[QuickTime metadata atoms](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quicktime-file-format/metadata_atoms_and_types),
[QuickTime GPS tag locations](https://exiftool.org/TagNames/QuickTime.html).
